about: The locked text layers of the series, taken from the first finished film (examples/nvidia-2001) and checked against its frames. compose_episode.py draws them; tests/text_lock.py fails if its values ever differ from this file. Do not edit this file to change a film: the look is the series'. Canvas 1080x1920; y is pixels from the top.

notice.carries: AI 生成 · 虚构剧情 (money topics add · 不构成投资建议)

premise.carries: the film's one or two title lines, 9 characters or fewer each

date_line.carries: the date or day count of the scene, e.g. 2007年　买入第约2555天
date_line.timing: the first one with the premise; each later one alone for 4 seconds when the date changes, with a soft click

subtitle.carries: every spoken line, one part (10 characters or fewer) at a time; no punctuation except ? where needed
subtitle.timing: while the line is spoken (timed by speech recognition)

narration.carries: text-only status lines ending in two dots, 2-7 characters: 来买股票了..
narration.strip: the same black strip as a subtitle
narration.timing: at the opening or close of a shot, while nobody speaks

super.carries: a figure or place the script puts on screen; not used in the first film
super.timing: the first 3 seconds of a scene

rules: Only these six layers exist. Nothing else is drawn on the picture.
All text is white; no accent colours; no text in the generated picture itself.
A subtitle line over 10 characters is split into parts at the script's own punctuation, never shrunk.
Subtitles and narration never show at the same time in the same place.
